label: Rakuten Ichiba
terms_note: Rakuten Ichiba shop contract (Japanese entity, monthly plan + fees); WEB SERVICE applied for inside RMS; serviceSecret is permanent, licenseKey expires every 3 months (Rakuten e-mails before expiry) — manual renewal in RMS; each API method must be enabled in 利用設定; rate limits documented per API inside RMS (not readable without login); no public sandbox.

discovery.auth: api_key (serviceSecret + licenseKey from RMS › WEB SERVICE › 利用設定; `Authorization: ESA base64(serviceSecret:licenseKey)`; licence key valid 3 months, renewed manually)
sdks: community .NET client covering 15+ RMS API families — https://github.com/JakeJP/Rakuten.RMS.Api

auth: 1. Shop applies for WEB SERVICE in RMS and enables the API methods it needs (ItemAPI, RakutenPay OrderAPI, InventoryAPI …).
2. Copy serviceSecret + licenseKey from 基本設定 › 利用設定 › 利用情報 into the platform.
3. Renew the licenseKey in RMS every 3 months (expiry mail from Rakuten) — the client must surface expiry as an action card.

endpoints.purpose: create / update items (manageNumber, title, price, images, variants)
orders, confirm, tracking (配送会社 + 伝票番号)
coupons, shop settings, licence expiry check

reference.limits: Documented per API inside RMS (login-walled); not read. - Rakuten shop contract; API use enabled per method by the shop. - Licence key rotation every 3 months is mandatory.
mcp_sdk: SDK: community .NET client covering 15+ RMS API families — https://github.com/JakeJP/Rakuten.RMS.Api

reason: Re-opened 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: https://webservice.rms.rakuten.co.jp/merchant-portal/view/ja/common/1-1_service_index/ redirects to https://mainmenu.rms.rakuten.co.jp/?act=app_login_error ('認証エラーが発生しました … R-Loginのログイン画面に戻り'), so the RMS WEB SERVICE specs (ItemAPI 2.0, InventoryAPI 2.1, RakutenPayOrderAPI) are readable only inside a logged-in RMS session. No call can be mapped from official docs (community wrappers are not a source).
